info.name: NEYU Health API (local)
info.description:
Run against your PC: npm run dev → baseUrl http://localhost:3000.
Order matters inside each folder (sign in first — Postman keeps the session cookie).
Origin header is required: the API rejects requests from other sites (CSRF protection).
Variables: patientEmail / patientPassword (demo patient), staffEmail / staffPassword (your staff account),
totpSecret = the key under 'Can't scan? Type this key' on the 2-step setup screen (Postman makes the 6-digit code from it).

request.description: Creates a new account each run (timestamped email). Needs a working email setup to receive the code; the account is created either way.

exec: // Remember an existing report, so 'Download' still works when the upload below is a duplicate (409) on a re-run.
const j = pm.response.json(); const id = (j.document||j.doc||j).id; if (id) pm.collectionVariables.set('docId', id);
pm.test('4 consents with policy version', () => { pm.expect(j.consents.length).to.eql(4); pm.expect(j.consents.find(x => x.kind === 'terms').version).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('asks for the 2-step code (not first-time setup)', () => {
if (j.step === 'setup') throw new Error('2-step is not set up yet: sign in once at /admin in the browser and scan the QR code first.');
// Makes the 6-digit code from totpSecret (the key shown under 'Can't scan? Type this key' when you set up 2-step).
if (!secret) throw new Error('Set totpSecret (your 2-step key) — see the collection description.');
for (const ch of secret) { const i = A.indexOf(ch); if (i < 0) throw new Error('totpSecret has a wrong character: ' + ch); bits += i.toString(2).padStart(5, '0'); }
let hex = ''; for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) hex += parseInt(bits.substr(i, 8), 2).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
// If this fails with 'code isn't right' right after another run: wait 30 seconds (each code works once).

item.name: Patient record → asks for a reason (break-glass)

exec: pm.test('reason asked (403) — or already open from a reason in the last 60 min (200)', () => {
pm.test('roles + menu', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.roles).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.nav).to.include('settings'); });

pm.test('400 validation_error with field', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('validation_error'); pm.expect(e.details[0].path).to.eql('limit'); });
pm.test('200, or reason asked (super admin: privacy needs a reason)', () => pm.expect([200, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('does not say which part was wrong', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/email or password/));
